blocks.html:
Truck Decals & Truck Lettering – Vinyl Wrap Toronto

When it comes to spreading awareness about your brand, there are countless ways to achieve it. How you choose to promote your business depends on the industry you’re working for and your target customers.

If you’re working in an industry that involves using trucks or vans to carry out your business duties, we have the solution that will advertise your business for years to come with a one-time investment.

That magic solution is Truck Decals & Lettering.

Truck Decals:

Decals are variable-sized vinyl stickers cut out in a specified shape and size. A couple of decals have the ability to turn your vehicle into a moving billboard. Or if you just want to personalize your vehicle with your favourite design or logo, decals are the way to go. Truck Decals give you full freedom to do the following:

  1. The Shape & Size: No matter what shape or size your logo has, we can turn it into a decal and install it on your truck.
  2. Colour & Finish: You get to choose from a wide spectrum of eye-catching colours and finishes from 3M and Avery Dennison (Matte, Gloss, Satin).
  3. Installation and Removal Any Time: Truck Decals are easy to apply and be removed by professionals.
  4. Anywhere on your Vehicle: Truck Decals can be installed almost anywhere on the vehicle including but not limited to, the hood, roof, sides, back, windows, etc.

Truck Lettering:

As the name suggests, lettering is vinyl stickers cut out to make letters and put together to form words and sentences. Truck Lettering allows you to put your slogans or favourite quotes on your vehicle. Here are some of the things you have full control over if you wish to get truck lettering:

  1. The Font & Size: You can get your text in any font you desire and have it cut out in any size you want.
  2. Colour & Finish: Similar to decals, you get full freedom to choose the colour that you wish to get as well as the finish such as Matte, Gloss, and Satin.
  3. Easy to Install and Remove: Lettering is as quick to remove as install if you wish to take it off, no matter the reason if done by a professional.

To help you make a decision, here are some of the advantages of truck decals and truck lettering as opposed to other means of advertising:

  1. Decals & lettering are very cost-effective considering their lifetime.
  2. Once installed, decals & lettering can last for years before you have to think about replacing or removing them.
  3. Truck Decals are easy to install and remove.
  4. Decals have been proven to be an effective and non-aggressive way of advertising.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have professional installers who have been working in the industry for more than a decade. Over the years, we’ve made an unshakable reputation for ourselves. We work with clients from all over the GTA and particular cities like Mississauga, Etobicoke, Vaughan, Oakville, Scarborough, and Brampton.

For more info, read: Benefits of decals

If you’re considering getting decals, a full vehicle wrap, or a partial wrap, we’re here to make it happen for you. For any queries, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W1B4 to see us in action.

To read more about vehicle wraps, please visit our blog page. Check out more truck decals here.
